name: @ecommerce-load/infra
description: Local infrastructure dependencies (Postgres, Redis) for the Medusa application

scripts.up: if [ "$SKIP_LOCAL_INFRA" = "1" ]; then echo 'SKIP_LOCAL_INFRA=1 — using managed Postgres/Redis, not starting containers.'; else docker compose up -d --wait; fi
scripts.down: if [ "$SKIP_LOCAL_INFRA" = "1" ]; then echo 'SKIP_LOCAL_INFRA=1 — nothing local to stop.'; else docker compose down; fi
scripts.psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U medusa -d medusa
